sequence.info: Order of the intervention phases and how their steps are carried out.
sequence.title: Intervention sequencing
sequence.helperText: An intervention is split into ordered sequences. Phases of a linear sequence are carried out one after the other, phases of a parallel sequence in any order. In the field, a step can only be completed once the mandatory elements of the steps before it are filled in; an optional phase does not block.
sequence.unlockInfo: Unlocking lifts the sequencing restriction for this step. The action is recorded in the intervention history.
